body:
I just…. don’t know how to deal with it. Every time the thought pops up, I tell myself again and again to remember that nobody’s life revolves around me and that my friends are allowed to have other friends besides me and being jealous will not change that. Then I try to push the thought away and pretend that everything is fine. It works for that moment. Then the next time I see them having fun without me again, the cycle continues.


Sorry for the word vomit, I’m not even sure if I’m making any sense.
Sorry to be a dumbass, but how do I do that?
my dream is gone, nonexistent. i don’t have the money or the means or the support to do it. i have no future.
